title: M31 — Original physical cash counts and closing review

pages.note: M31 supplies no dedicated closing-review frame. Uses the supplied phone and desktop Today frames for monochrome cards, typography, spacing and controls. Actual scoped local SQL/HTTP; Auth and Realtime identities are explicit test fixtures. Pixel differences are informational.
